stage: M66 native finite-change coordination atlas; no fit
population: All70 M57 training pairs and14 M59 source-group evaluation pairs, retain split/family labels and existing ineligible unequal-length source positions. Layers0,1,2, both endpoints, source/final/identity. No new task exposure or selecting strong effects.
object: Native finite task-change contributions, not intact write contributions or full-neuron removal. For aligned inputs z_r,z_d, product change c_j = L_j(z_d)R_j(z_d)-L_j(z_r)R_j(z_r), vector contribution v_j=Down[:,j]*c_j. Sum is donor-minus-recipient product write; output bias cancels.
exact_theory: With dz=z_d-z_r, c = L(z_r)*R(dz) + L(dz)*R(z_r) + L(dz)*R(dz), at the normalized MLP input boundary. Verify linear branch assumptions/biases before using expansion. This finite identity does not linearize normalization upstream. Compare recipient/donor anchors explicitly.
metrics: For each fixed condition, S=||sum_j v_j||^2; C=sum_j||v_j||^2; signed cross sum S-C; participation C^2/sum_j||v_j||^4; relative norm/error for linear and quadratic expansion terms. Concatenate selected positions before norms. Record native delta magnitude, same-token versus changed-token address status, per-family and pooled metrics. Explicit null denominators. No cancellation claim from C alone.
prediction: Distributed constructive task changes have broad participation with S>C; net cancelling changes have S<C. Large intact-write cancellation need not imply cancellation of the task-changing difference. These can coexist with token clustering or behavioral insensitivity.
theory_checks: For uniformly selected k of N channels, E||missing sum||^2=(1-k/N)^2*S + (k/N)*(1-k/N)*(N*C-S)/(N-1). For exactly half retained, doubling has expected error (N*C-S)/(N-1). Independently validate formulas by enumeration on small known synthetic vectors and fixed Monte Carlo on native coefficients; not behavioral evidence.
verification: Hash-bound protocol and pinned model. Replay native final logits against M57/M59 where available; verify exact channel sums and finite bilinear expansion in float64 from saved captures/weights with numerical residuals reported. Independent NumPy energy/participation and synthetic expectation checks. Preserve all failures and alignment omissions.
deliverable: Native change atlas identifying whether computational differences are concentrated/distributed/constructive/cancelling across layers, plus continuous channel-coordinate supervision targets for later featurizers. This is descriptive mechanism evidence; native response and removal tests remain distinct.
stop: One all-condition atlas and independent audit. No channel selection, fitting, or outcome-guided layer/task search. Then freeze one matched native intervention test of channel-change subsets before inspecting its responses; do not infer native redundancy from local geometry.
holdouts: Retain train/evaluation labels. All historical whole-task training exclusions unchanged. Familiar source-group evaluation is development, not pristine whole-task generalization.
